system.title: One view. The whole system.
system.description: Keep store activity, system availability and AI features in one workspace.

overview.title: Current activity
overview.description: Metrics from connected sources. Refresh to check again.
overview.backendHint: Checks the API response only, not database or external service health.
overview.roundTripHint: One browser round trip, not system-wide average latency or p95.
overview.staffHint: All three departments, including banned staff accounts.
overview.partialError: Some sources could not be loaded
overview.partialErrorHint: Unverified values appear as —. Check the Backend and try refreshing.

registrations.title: Application breakdown
registrations.description: Application review status, not account activation status.
registrations.unavailable: Application statistics could not be loaded.
registrations.emptyHint: The chart will appear when the first application is received.

sources.title: Data sources
sources.description: See which sources currently provide data.
sources.note: A successful API response does not establish that every service is healthy.

traffic.title: System traffic & errors
traffic.description: Requests, error rates and latency over time.
traffic.hint: This chart will appear once request, error and latency measurements are available.

reports.title: Business reports
reports.description: Review and export reports with a clear basis, time period and currency.
reports.filtersHint: Choose a reporting period in Vietnam time.
reports.waitingHint: Preview and export become available when report data is connected.
reports.chartHint: Only verified transactions matching the filters will be included.
reports.emptyHint: Unpaid order values are not displayed as payments received.
reports.definition: Payments received and completed order value are separate measures. Cancellation does not mean a refund was issued; unavailable values are not zero.

ai.title: AI activity
ai.description: Model usage, response quality and UI rendering outcomes.
ai.tokensHint: Actual usage by model and feature.
ai.uiSuccessHint: Based on validation and rendering results.
ai.usageHint: By model, feature and recorded time.
ai.emptyHint: No verified token, model error or UI fallback metrics are available yet.
ai.billingNote: Estimated costs and actual charges require separate data sources from the model provider.

settings.title: Draft AI configuration
settings.description: Prepare proposed settings before connecting a service.
settings.draftNotice: Drafts are saved only in this browser session for the signed-in Admin. No settings have been applied to the system.
settings.modelHint: Model availability will be verified when the service is connected.
settings.errorHint: Failed requests within a measurement window; define that window before applying.
settings.budgetHint: An alert relative to the configured budget, not a discount percentage.
settings.chatHint: Explain and guide using authorized data.
settings.generativeUiHint: Render UI using approved components and actions.
settings.saved: Draft saved for this session. System configuration has not changed.
settings.storageError: The browser could not save the draft. Your current inputs have been retained.
settings.deleted: Session draft deleted. System configuration has not changed.
settings.connectionHint: Model checks become available after a service connection and access permissions are established.
settings.noDraft: No draft saved in this session.
settings.modelLimitsHint: Initial values are suggestions. Verify model limits and capabilities before applying settings.

validation.modelLength: The model ID must not exceed 256 characters.
validation.modelRequired: Enter a primary model before proposing an enabled AI feature.
validation.differentModel: Choose a fallback model different from the primary model.
validation.tokens: Enter an integer from 1 to 1,000,000; model limits must be verified separately.
validation.timeout: Enter an integer from 5 to 120 seconds.

logs.title: Activity log & alerts
logs.description: Trace errors, configuration changes and administrative activity.
logs.searchHint: Request ID, error code or event details
logs.emptyHint: Filters become available when verified log and alert sources are connected.
logs.draftNote: Browser configuration drafts do not create a system audit history. The Backend must record administrative changes when they are applied.
